title: Hirriba Yeroo Darbe
intro: Mee yeroo dhugaan callifamee amantoonni adamfamani yaadi. Gareen xiqqaan tokko harka kennachuu irra duubatti deebi'uu filate, bakka baay'ee hin fakkaanne keessatti baqannaa argate — bakka jaarraa lakkaa'amuu bira darbee bakka boqonnaa isaanii ta'u. Dhumarratti yeroo dammaqan addunyaan naannoo isaaniitti jijjiiramee ture. Lubbuuwwan hirriba keessa jiran kun eenyu?
clues: Dargaggoota magaalaa durii keessa jiraachaa turre.
Hawaasni keenya isaan cinaa akka waaqeffannu gaafate, nuti garuu didde.
Warra amantaa keenya morman jalaa baqannee magaalattii baqanne.
Hiriyaan amanamaan miila afur qabu tokko seensa bakka dhokannee turre irra bule.
Rabbiin waggaa dhibba sadii fi sagal nu raffise.
Dhumarratti yeroo dammaqnu, magaalaan keenya yeroo tokko ariʼatamaa turte amantii fudhattee turte.

outcome.answer: Magaalaan keenya gara amantiitti akka garagalte arginee dammaqne

arabic: وَلَبِثُوا۟ فِى كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَـٰثَ مِا۟ئَةٍۢ سِنِينَ وَٱزْدَادُوا۟ تِسْعًۭا
verse: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine. (18:25)
